notes: Skills bundled with Claude Code itself: they have no SKILL.md on disk, so the catalog cannot discover them. Short descriptions written for routing; lowest precedence (any project, user or plugin skill of the same name shadows them). Edit or empty this list freely; per-machine overrides go to builtin.local.json (same shape, replaces this list).

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review the current diff, a branch or a pull request for correctness bugs, with an effort level; can post inline PR comments or apply fixes.

skills.name: simplify
skills.description: Review changed code for reuse, simplification and efficiency cleanups and apply them. Quality only, not a bug hunt.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Security review of the pending changes on the current branch.

skills.name: init
skills.description: Create a CLAUDE.md file documenting the codebase for future sessions.

skills.name: claude-api
skills.description: Reference for building with the Claude API / Anthropic SDK: model ids, pricing, tool use, streaming, caching, agents, model migration.

skills.name: workflow-authoring
skills.description: Write and run a multi-agent workflow script that orchestrates many subagents (fan out, pipeline, verify).

skills.name: loop
skills.description: Run a prompt or slash command repeatedly on an interval, or self-paced, e.g. poll a deploy every 5 minutes.

skills.name: schedule
skills.description: Create, list or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) on a cron schedule, or one-time at a set time.

skills.name: run
skills.description: Launch and drive this project's app (CLI, server, web, Electron) to see a change working, take screenshots.

skills.name: update-config
skills.description: Configure Claude Code settings.json: hooks for automated behaviours, permissions, environment variables.

skills.name: fewer-permission-prompts
skills.description: Scan transcripts for common read-only tool calls and add an allowlist to project settings to reduce permission prompts.
